'''Hitomi Kikuchi''' (Japanese: '''菊地瞳''' ''Kikuchi Hitomi'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. 

==Biography==
Kikuchi was born on June 13 1987 in {{wp|Shizuoka Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. Her biggest role in the {{pkmn|animated series}} is {{an|Lana}}, one of {{ashcl|Ash's classmates}}, during {{aniseries|SM}}. Kikuchi is currently affiliated with the talent group Aksent.
